name: Lake Zhava
description: A dark, deep lake in the highlands of Nephalia near the Gavony border, home of the Gitrog.

timeline.summary: Mia and Wilbur argue about whether the Gitrog is real; Wilbur lashes out about Mia's absent father, then they reconcile.
timeline.quote: Is that what your father told you when he left you behind? That you don't matter?

timeline.summary: Elder Kalim announces that he has seen the Gitrog and that fishing on the lake is suspended; he has written to the Church and suggests Mia write her father.
timeline.quote: The Elders convened last night, and we decree that fishing on the lake is suspended until further notice.

timeline.summary: The postal rider stops coming, and the rumor spreads that the Gitrog devoured the mail carrier.
timeline.quote: Within two days, accounts of the Gitrog devouring the mail carrier transformed from rumor to story to fact.

timeline.summary: Armed hooded patrols begin walking the village streets as winter deepens.
timeline.quote: As winter deepened, armed men and women began patrolling the streets

timeline.summary: Mia discovers the tracks are faked by someone and follows human footprints to the lake.
timeline.quote: Someone had gone to the trouble of faking an attack, of making false prints, then sweeping away their tracks.

timeline.summary: Mia demands that Kalim show her the Gitrog, and the villagers throw the carcasses into the lake.
The Gitrog surfaces beside the boat and Mia sees it for the first time.
timeline.quote: As the water settled, she saw it. The monster. The Gitrog.

timeline.summary: Mia sets the ship afire and dives into the icy lake with Wilbur, swimming back to shore.
timeline.quote: She turned forward and without a pause dove into the icy water, dragging Wilbur with her.

timeline.summary: The Gitrog follows them ashore and Mia falls into its gaze, seeing what she takes for truth.
timeline.quote: She saw truth in its blackest form, the clarity of a thousand lifetimes compressed into one moment.

timeline.summary: Mia, smiling, stabs Wilbur with her dagger as an offering.
timeline.quote: smiled as she slid her dagger out of its sheath and through his rib cage in one smooth motion.

timeline.summary: Mia bows to the Gitrog, declaring all is sacrifice, and it eats Wilbur's body.
timeline.quote: a monstrous tongue lapped out, grasping the body of the broken boy beside her.

relations.note: It retreats to the lake after its attacks.
relations.quote: perhaps even catch sight of it before it slipped back into the lake

pages_say.description: A dark, deep lake in the highlands of Nephalia near the Gavony border, home of the Gitrog.
